title: Draft Press Statement — DO NOT RELEASE

body.text:
DRAFT — REGIONAL PRESS STATEMENT

A structural collapse at a decommissioned deep-storage facility has resulted in the loss of the site. There were no personnel on-site at the time of the incident. The area poses no risk to the public.

Annotation, O5 liaison: approved for use in the event of a GLASS COFFIN conclusion. The phrase 'no personnel on-site' is accurate as of the moment of release, by definition: reclassification of on-site persons to materiel completes at detonation.
